test: bank integration on real data, zero readout
what_ran: --bank build inside kgfm/crest:dev: 16 relation ids x 20 sampled edges, each a real TRIX forward with the sampled edge and its inverse removed, type-compatible plus self-adversarial negatives, rows detached and cached

results.ranks_vs_trix: 746 of 746 identical with the bank BUILT (not skipped)

why_it_matters: phase 0 ran with --bank skip, so this is the first execution of the phase 2 machinery on real tensors. Identity surviving a built bank proves the zeroed readout truly gates the whole readout path, and the 37.5s -> 0.0s rerun proves the disk cache keyed on (graph, checkpoint, seed) works -- the property stage B's cost control depends on.
projection: 16 ids in 37.5s is ~2.3s per relation id cold. The suite's 6482 ids project to ~4.2 GPU-hours for a full one-time bank build, in line with the plan's 259,280-forward estimate; FBIngram-sized graphs dominate.
